pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take: Gunner's doin' work at the top, but he's out here draftin' DR Congo like his barber's runnin' a side hustle in Kinshasa. **Bubba G gonna try puttin' some French flair on Devin's Ghost Pepper edition of Spain, but it might end up hotter than a Tex-Mex dish in Arlington.** France is lookin' strong and sittin' top of the group, while Spain's been playin' peek-a-boo with the real contenders. Now Gunner's tryna back himself with that Senegalese spice and Moroccan magic, while Devin's dreamin' that the USA'll show up like it’s the Fourth of July every day. I'm callin' it: France gonna light it up bigger than fireworks over Big Sky Country. Rafe, meanwhile, is feelin' comfortable at the bottom of the standings, maybe 'cause Uzbekistan ain't exactly known for their World Cup heroics. That Noisemaker's picks are as wild as his dad's backpasses, but hey, at least he's consistent at keepin' it unpredictable.
